title: InvestmentOverview
description: data of get_investments and GET /v1/investments (ADR-044): the user's investments at a provider. source statement: the newest verified investment statement (balances per fund and series on as_of) and transactions certificate (contributions and withdrawals) the user imported, read by the backend and checked to add up; each goal's value is its part of the printed balances by its shares, and only when both documents describe the same shares (documents_agree); the gain only when the certificate also starts when the account opened (contributions.complete). source sync: the last snapshot of a linked account (in development), as the provider reported it at synced_at. Amounts are integers in pesos; totals, contributions, averages and gains are computed by the backend; shares and values per share are exact decimal text. Goal names are the user's labels at the provider, wrapped as untrusted text. stale: a sync over 24 hours old or a statement over a month old; synthetic: the offline sandbox fixture. Facts (unit = currency unless noted): investments.total_value, investments.funds (count), investments.fund.<fund_id>.value, investments.contributed, investments.withdrawn, investments.total_deposited (net), investments.contributions and investments.withdrawals (count), investments.monthly_contribution, investments.history_months and investments.contribution_months (count), investments.total_gain, investments.gain_pct (%), investments.goals (count), investments.goal.<goal_id>.value|deposited|gain. Warnings: INVESTMENTS_FROM_STATEMENT or INVESTMENTS_AS_REPORTED always, and INVESTMENTS_STATEMENT_OLD, INVESTMENTS_NO_BALANCE, INVESTMENTS_NO_HISTORY, INVESTMENTS_PARTIAL_HISTORY, INVESTMENTS_DOCUMENTS_DISAGREE, INVESTMENTS_SYNTHETIC and INVESTMENTS_STALE when they apply. With nothing imported or linked the envelope is INSUFFICIENT_DATA with missing ["investment_account"].

as_of.description: The day the values describe: the statement's day (else the certificate's last movement), or the sync's day.

total_value.description: Null when only the transactions certificate was imported.

total_gain.description: total_value - total_deposited; negative is a loss.

gain_pct.description: total_gain / total_deposited x 100, one decimal, rounded half up.

documents.description: The documents these figures come from (statement source).

documents_agree.description: The statement and the certificate describe the same shares per fund and series; null unless both are imported.

value.description: Null when the imported documents do not describe the same shares.

deposited.description: Net contributions (contributions less withdrawals, moves between the user's goals included), when known.

fund.description: The provider's fund name, e.g. Risky Norris.

contributions.description: Money from and to the bank in the transactions certificate; moves between the user's own goals are not contributions.

months.description: Calendar months from first_day to last_day, both included.

complete.description: Every goal, fund and series starts from zero shares: the certificate holds the whole history.
